name: Funding-flip recovery into fear (cross_up funding through zero + fear gate)
rationale: A timing-precise capitulation entry built around the funding REGIME FLIP rather than a static level. During a flush funding goes negative (shorts pay); the bottom is often marked when funding crosses BACK UP through ~zero as shorts cover — the squeeze ignition. This spec arms a long on that funding cross_up (event-based, the correct op for a transition) WHILE Fear&Greed confirms the crowd is still fearful (we want the flip to happen INTO fear, before sentiment has recovered). funding_rate is BOUNDED so a level filter is normally allowed, but here the THESIS is the transition, so cross_up is the honest operator for it; the fear_greed level gate supplies the sentiment-agreement half of the niche. Funding is crowding/positioning signal (null carry). DISCONFIRMER: a static funding-level (lt ceiling) + fear sibling is in this cohort — if the cross_up event version does not beat the static-level version on the purged holdout, the 'flip' framing adds no timing edge and is the same level filter dressed up as an event. If neither trades enough, honest insufficient-evidence. Gate disposes.
catalyst: funding crosses up through ~zero (short-cover ignition) while fear persists
